imitation_target_space.diagnosis: update-6 isolated synergy at 986066: MAPPO-initialised policy commands >= 2.0 m/s^2 on 95% of steps (median 2.6, bound [-3, 2.6]) but the CAV vType cav_typical accel cap is 1.2 m/s^2 (speedMode 27 also respects the leader safe speed); median headroom (command minus realised) 1.46 m/s^2 -> most commands lie in a DEAD ZONE where every command has identical effect; the raw AWR likelihood learned a near-uniform -0.25 m/s^2 shift that never crossed the binding limit, so group behaviour did not change (|dv| < 2e-6) despite ~0.9 m/s^2 'action error'
imitation_target_space.binding_limit_u_t: per imitation pair/step/member, from the winning plan branch's recorded observable tape (observable.jsonl.gz): u_t = min(cav_typical vType accel cap, each recorded observable the plan command exceeded). Recorded observables used: actions[].issued_safe (the safety-boundary issued command of that vehicle at that second) and the LABEL-SIDE realised acceleration ((v_mps[t+1] - v_mps[t]) / 1 s - frame t is written BEFORE env.step (tools/coopfree/backend.py), so the command at t acts over [t, t+1]); the last pair without a t+1 outcome frame is EXCLUDED and counted (never imputed). The cap is READ from the vType definition (traffic_shepherd/c4/population.py TEXTBOOK_CAV_PARAMS['accel_mps2'], the cav_typical params the scenario writer emits) - never hard-coded, no per-vehicle truth tables. Sample stores binding_limits = {vid: u_t - native_command} (residual space, the policy's action space); pairs whose trace lacks a member's limit data are EXCLUDED and counted (never imputed), and a pair whose recorded action residual disagrees with the tape command by > 1e-6 is excluded as a command mismatch
imitation_target_space.likelihood_rule: censored (Tobit) likelihood for the same AR(1)-correlated Gaussian (RHO=.5, policy.log_std): target below its limit -> the exact normal log-density at the target (identical to the raw term); target at/above its limit -> log P(policy command >= u_t) with the shared factor integrated by fixed-node Gauss-Hermite (64 nodes; matches the closed form Phi((mu-u)/sigma) for n=1 to ~1e-7), so ANY policy command above u_t is equally correct there and the likelihood never pulls the policy into the dead zone. log Phi uses torch.special.log_ndtr (stable tails, non-zero gradient at 40 sigma). AWR weights unchanged. With no binding target the term equals tools/coopfree/policy.gaussian_log_prob exactly
imitation_target_space.report: report keys action_error_before/after_mps2 and per-pass l1_action_error_before/after move to the EFFECTIVE space min(command, u_t) vs min(a*, u_t); report gains imitation_target_space='effective' and an 'effective' block: binding_share (share of binding target steps), binding_member_actions, member_actions, effective_action_error_binding_mps2, mean_policy_action_on_binding_mps2 vs mean_limit_on_binding_mps2 on binding steps
imitation_target_space.intent_targets: the plan members' future plan commands (v2v_intent.attach_bank_targets) are clipped to min(command, u_t) in ABSOLUTE space (limits_by_time, u_t derived from the SAME v[t+1]-v[t] outcomes) when the option is on
